why: The one expectation every Host is measured against for the same Catalog. Stage 11's plan asked for a Web/Native refusal-consistency table; before this file each Host suite carried its own idea of the answer, so two Hosts could disagree and both stay green. Assert equality with the whole partition, never containment: a Set silently promoted from refused to published, or a refusal that changes its locked token, has to fail somewhere, and only equality makes it fail.
authority: docs/plans/2026-09-06-lmdj-stage11-sound-set.md Locked Error Reasons, and docs/design/2026-08-31-lmdj-stage11-sound-set-design.md S11-D3. This file records what Core decides for tests/fixtures/soundset; it does not decide anything itself, and a disagreement with those documents is a bug here.

not_covered_here: Published is not installable. soundset_audio_unsupported (Fixture Unsupported Audio Kit, 33333333-...) is decided at install, not at list, so it appears in `published` above and its refusal belongs to an install leg. soundset_manifest_invalid, soundset_slot_invalid and soundset_occupied_conflict are likewise decided elsewhere: this file is the list partition only, and a Host that agreed here could still disagree at install.
